text_block_list.text: One day, when I came to the park――

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, mister. Play with meee!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, miss. Play with meee!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry for jumping in so suddenly...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've been hanging out with this kid a lot 
lately. Seems like she's waiting for her 
mom to finish work.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So, apparently she wants to play tag 
today. Just the two of us isn't quite 
enough, though. And so~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like! If it's really, truuuly 
okay with you! ...Would you like to come 
along?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Man, even though I'm used to looking after 
my little sisters, playing tag with just 
the two of us... was pretty high 
difficulty.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But don't push yourself too hard, 
okay? You must be tired from work and all.
choice_data_list: Just take it easy and have fun.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew, good job! Casual tag was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Take it easy on the run and conserve 
stamina, then dash when the moment 
strikes...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh! I feel like that was great 
training♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Good work~. ...Man, to think you'd play so 
hard without holding back against a kid's 
endless energy...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing! You looked so incredibly 
cool!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I ended up getting all fired up myself♪

Playing tag was pretty exhausting, but... 
seeing Ines Fujin run up close like that 
was truly informative.
